topic.title: per-compound counts derived from PubChem’s
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: Is it allowed to use per-compound counts derived from PubChem’s public FTP Extras files (number of substance records via CID-SID, number of PubMed references via CID-PMID) as a ranking feature in a prize-eligible solution?
